question: Calculate: \(200 + 150 + 50 = ?\)
solution: Add from left to right: \(200+150=350\), then \(350+50=400\).

edges.reason: The target includes chained subtraction. Each step subtracts within ten, so the subtraction operation is a component even though addition-only chains need no subtraction.
Column addition reinforces place-value alignment and regrouping. Mental hundreds/tens sums can be obtained by decomposition and unit counts without laying out written columns.
Mental arithmetic on hundreds and tens uses the values of those places in three-digit numbers.
